title: Intentions of the grays 'Bones' and 'Spock' in Project Preserve Destiny

tellings.quote:
Um, well, I think they were soldiers. I
mean, not not military, but like they
were

plain: A former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman says that in the 1990s he was part of Project Preserve Destiny, a secret program in which, he says, the NSA, the US agency that gathers signals intelligence, had him receive messages from aliens. Asked what the grays he dealt with were after, short gray-skinned beings he nicknamed "Bones" and "Spock," Sherman says he thinks they were soldiers, "not military, but like they were" workers carrying out orders. He offers it as his own view from his time in the program, which would mean the beings he talked to worked for someone above them.
